theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  refine ⟨.choice h, fun s1 s2 hr μ => ?_⟩
  cases hr
  case bisim hb =>
    refine ⟨fun _ htr => ?_, fun _ htr => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨y, hy, .bisim hr'⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨y, hy, .bisim hr'⟩
  case choice hb =>
    refine ⟨fun _ htr => ?_, fun _ htr => ?_⟩
    · cases htr
      case choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨y, .choiceL hy, .bisim hr'⟩
      case choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨_, .choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · cases htr
      case choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hr'⟩ := hb.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨y, .choiceL hy, .bisim hr'⟩
      case choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨_, .choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩

  constructor
  · constructor; assumption
  intro s1 s2 r μ
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr2
        · constructor

      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr
        · constructor
          apply HomBisimilarity.refl
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
      exists s2'
      constructor
      · assumption
      constructor
      apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim

        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr1
        · constructor
          apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exists s2'
